capabilities: Browse autoplans.dev projects and tasks in a sidebar
Sync project task lists with notes in both directions
Push a note to a project as a tracked task
Render a project as a visual task map with dependencies
Serve vault notes to AI agents over an MCP server
extras: Part of the broader Autoplans ecosystem (web dashboard, desktop app, CLI, VS Code extension). MCP server is desktop-only and off by default; self-hosting of the endpoint is supported; error reporting is opt-in.
problem: Developers who plan in Markdown need their notes to stay in step with tasks tracked in a real project system instead of maintaining both by hand.

relations.evidence: Works with the Tasks plugin and Dataview.
Works with the Tasks plugin and Dataview.
Serve your notes to AI coding agents — Claude Code, the Autoplans desktop app, any MCP client.

requires.name: MCP client such as Claude Code

summary: Integration client for autoplans.dev that syncs project tasks with notes two ways, shows task maps, and exposes the vault over MCP.
